claim_boundary: This is a fabrication/handling specification, not experimental evidence of transfer stability or device performance.

fixture.design_intent: Repeatable non-contact edge registration and protected shipment/remounting of one 25 mm square R2 substrate without clamping the active/encapsulated central region.
fixture.registration_datum: Two perpendicular hard datums at substrate edges plus one compliant opposite-corner retainer; no force applied over the central keepout.
fixture.carrier_material_requirement: dimensionally stable, electrically insulating, low-shedding material compatible with facility EHS and device encapsulation; material not yet frozen
fixture.fastener_requirement: tool-accessible, captive where practical, no loose hardware above active face
fixture.contact_access: At least one full edge of the carrier remains open or relieved to permit access to exposed contact pads without removing substrate from carrier.
fixture.optical_access: Carrier must not intrude into the 8 mm diameter optical exclusion/collection zone around the selected pixel.
fixture.labeling: Carrier ID, substrate blind ID, orientation arrow, datum A/B marks, and configuration revision must remain visible after packing.

shipping_insert.design_intent: Immobilize the loaded carrier inside a secondary box while avoiding direct load on substrate or encapsulation lid.
shipping_insert.carrier_retention: Restrain carrier perimeter on four sides; no foam/tape/adhesive may contact substrate, encapsulation lid, active-area face, or electrical contacts.
shipping_insert.orientation_control: Record as-packed and as-received orientation photos; orientation change alone is not an exclusion criterion.
shipping_insert.tamper_evidence: Record seal ID or equivalent package-integrity identifier when available; absence is provenance INCOMPLETE, not automatic scientific FAIL.

status_semantics.PASS: All required checks satisfied under frozen configuration.
status_semantics.FAIL: Contradictory identity, visible damage affecting measurement, fixture interference, or unsafe/nonconforming state.
status_semantics.INCOMPLETE: Required provenance/check record missing; do not silently convert to PASS.

dimensional_checks.contact_vs_keepout_note: The keepout is a conservative central no-clamp/no-contact region; actual contact-pad relief must be verified against the traveler before fabrication.
dimensional_checks.tolerance_policy: Fixture machining/printing tolerance must be specified by fabricator; any tolerance stack that can reduce planar pocket clearance below 0.05 mm or edge support below 2.0 mm requires redesign/review.

qualification_plan.counts_class: engineering screening assumptions, not statistical power claims
required_metrics: substrate insertion/removal without visible edge damage
qualification_plan.device_use_gate: Do not use the fixture on qualified R2 primaries until dummy-cycle screening passes and human review accepts material/contact compatibility.

rules: Do not use adhesives or foams in direct contact with device or encapsulation unless compatibility is separately qualified.
Avoid particle-shedding or conductive debris near contacts.
Do not apply retainer force over the central keepout or encapsulation lid.
Facility EHS, shipping, electrical, optical, and chemical-handling requirements remain controlling.
